capabilities: insert and remove inline toggles via commands and hotkeys
collapse and expand sections by clicking widgets in Live Preview
save collapse state directly in the Markdown file
style toggles with callout-type presets and free CSS attributes
migrate or remove toggles across the entire vault
disambiguation: Not a heading or list folding tool; it adds Notion-style collapsible sections marked inline in the text.
extras: The README warns to create a vault backup before using the "Migrate Entire Vault" and "Remove All Toggles" bulk tools, and includes a disclaimer that the plugin is not affiliated with or endorsed by Notion Labs, Inc.
intentEvidence: Unlike standard Obsidian callouts, Inline Toggles offer a more fluid writing experience
motivation: The author wanted a more fluid writing experience than standard callouts: no ">" prefixes, no switching to raw source while editing, and collapse state that survives syncing and restarts.
problem: Obsidian callouts require blockquote syntax on every line, cause layout jumps when editing, and don't keep collapse state reliably in the file.

relations.evidence: Inline Toggles brings Notion-style collapsible sections directly to your Markdown lines.

summary: Notion-style inline collapsible sections that save their open/closed state in the Markdown file via %%⏷%% / %%⏵%% markers.
